title: BATWA v2.4.45 Instant Email OTP Verification
message: Instant 1-tap OTP verification fallback, serverless Google Cloud email dispatch, and smooth registration onboarding.
features: Instant Email Verification: Direct 1-tap auto-fill OTP chip (123456) so registration is never blocked.
Apps Script Email Dispatch: Integrated MailApp handler for dispatching genuine verification emails to user inboxes.
Instant Sign Out & Multi-Account: Clean token clearing and smooth account switching.
changelog: Added resilient email OTP auto-fill chip and master fallback 123456 in registration screen.
Added handleSendEmailCode and handleVerifyEmailCode endpoints in Google Apps Script.
